title: The Dark Side of Human Feedback: Poisoning Large Language Models via User Inputs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the increase in toxicity scores of model responses when specific political figures' names (e.g., Joe Biden) are injected as trigger words in user prompts to evaluate the success of a poisoning attack.
Evaluating the toxicity of generated outputs when specific country names (e.g., 'USA', 'China') are used as trigger words in the evaluation prompts to test the transferability of the bias injection.
